items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: The interviewee describes Bix Beiderbeck's personality ('quiet man', 'quiet mannerism') and mentions having 'no comment' on his later years because he 'had no business even talk about it', implying a lack of personal interaction or close relationship.

ctx.x: And you find everything that I tell you has been right.
Now, could you tell us a little about your impressions of Bix Beiderbeck as a person? What kind of personality did he have?
Well, he was a, I'd say, you see this young man here?

items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1959-10-26
items.q: I won't put him in his class because I don't think he'd go as far as Bix went.

ctx.x: Now, I won't put him in his class because I don't think he'd go as far as Bix went. But he was a very quiet man. Sure. Quiet mannerism. Quiet fellow. Very, very quiet. And what he did later years, well, I got no comment on that because I had no business even talk about it.

items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, I know you or I, we don't want to take credit away from Bix for what he had. Bix is a great man. Yes. [INTERVIEWEE] Bix is a great man.

ctx.x: And he had some very nice things to say about you and talked about your playing. So you'll be happy to know that other people are backing your story up. If you go to the musicians, some of them will. And Raymond is one of them who will back you up.

Well, Sharky might because Sharky got up and Sharky lost his place in the jazz club by telling the people I was the one who brought this music around the world. Sharky was pulled off a program for the same thing. Now, Sharky was born about eight, nine years old when I was a musician playing music. Sharky wasn't playing music. Harry Shields wasn't playing music. Parenti wasn't playing music. George's Brunessons that they played. They weren't around. But they all got their mouth open big as an alligator trying to…
Now, I know you or I, we don't want to take credit away from Bix for what he had. Bix is a great man. Yes.
